authenticator: Synthetic ES256 signatures checked by the production WebAuthn verifier; no physical biometrics tested.

outcomes.name: Native permissions remain mandatory before approval
Hidden fields cannot leak through approval review or evidence
An authorized account still needs its own registered key
Real ES256 approval publishes exactly the stored Drupal draft
Direct and bulk entity mutation cannot bypass required approval
Another Drupal UID or passkey cannot approve the request
User verification and exact challenge are mandatory
Changed saved content invalidates pending approval
A replacement revision invalidates pending approval
Changed administrator policy invalidates pending approval
Revoked native permissions are rechecked at execution
Removed role membership is rechecked in the same user session
Drupal moderation transition permission governs publication
Publish failure rolls back node, hook effect, key counter, and evidence
Late hook content alteration fails exact persisted postconditions
Delete failure rolls back node, hook effect, key counter, and evidence
Concurrent completions in two Drupal processes commit one publication
Approved deletion retains independently verifiable evidence
Revoked passkey cannot approve a newly requested operation
